text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The governor of Tete province in western Mozambique, Virgilio Ferrao, says 25 people have been killed in floods in the Zambezi valley this month.

- Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano returned to Maputo on Wednesday from South Africa where he had talks on regional flashpoints with South African President Nelson Mandela, President Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe and President Quett Masire of Botswana.
